setup: Place a clean peach or compliant peach replica on the counter beside an empty shallow padded food-safe bowl.
Keep heavy fruit, knives, cleaners, and other pressure sources outside the bowl and placement path.
reset: Return the peach to the marked counter start pose and empty the bowl.
Inspect and clean the bowl and counter before resetting another delicate-fruit trial.
quality_checks: Compare the peach silhouette and surface before and after, then verify bowl support, stability, and food-safe contact.
Confirm no other object was stacked on or pressed against the peach.
failure_modes: Peach is squeezed, bruised, torn, dropped, or only partly supported.
Bowl tips or the peach rolls toward an edge.
Peach contacts a dirty surface or cleaning chemical.
consumables: Clean peach or approved peach replica

requirements.reason: The controlled recovery occurs at a marked kitchen-counter station.
The plum is the dropped object to recover and isolate.
The clean tray is the safe receiving and quarantine surface.
The task starts from a controlled fallen pose.
The dropped plum remains within the marked recovery surface.
The plum must be reachable without pushing it farther away.
Recovery and contamination inspection require visibility.
The clean tray must be available and stable before the plum is recovered.
Use an inert replica or a controlled clean protocol and quarantine any real fruit after a drop.
The plum must be safely acquired and placed on the tray.
The recovered object and tray condition require inspection.
The recovery is framed as a household food-handling error response.

success_criteria: The plum is fully supported on the clean food tray, marked as quarantined, and no longer at the drop location.
The tray remains stable and the recovered plum is not silently returned to food service.
setup: Use a clean controlled drop surface, an empty clean food tray, and an inert or approved plum replica; keep the recovery area free of cleaners and sharp tools.
If a real plum contacts an uncontrolled floor or contaminated surface, plan quarantine rather than reuse as edible food.
reset: Return the replica plum to the marked fallen pose and empty the clean tray.
Clean and inspect the tray and drop surface before another recovery trial.
quality_checks: Verify plum identity, full tray support, quarantine marking, no edge exposure, and visible surface condition.
Confirm the recovery did not spread contamination to the tray or counter.
failure_modes: Plum is pushed out of reach, dropped again, or placed partly outside the tray.
A real dropped fruit is mixed back into edible food without inspection.
The clean tray contacts a dirty surface or a cleaning chemical.
